sections_breakdown.name: Hero Section
sections_breakdown.description: Full-bleed editorial container with daylight photography, kinetic line reveal headline 'Elevate Your Space, Naturally.', supporting subheadline, Primary CTA 'Shop Pots & Planters', Secondary CTA 'Explore Vases', quick stats bar (Handcrafted Cement | All India Express Delivery | 100% Eco-conscious).

sections_breakdown.name: Shop Pots & Planters (Priority 1)
sections_breakdown.description: Grid of cement & textured planters with price in ₹, dimensions, finish badge, WhatsApp direct buy button (+91 7061712908), and Quick-View Modal trigger.

sections_breakdown.name: Discover Our Vases (Priority 2)
sections_breakdown.description: Curated highlight showcase for sculptural ceramics, ribbed vases, and textured vessels with material tags, height specs, and WhatsApp enquiry.

sections_breakdown.name: Featured Pots & Vases Spotlight
sections_breakdown.description: Interactive comparison/spotlight carousel of bestselling cement pots and statement vases side-by-side with living room styling suggestions.

sections_breakdown.name: Best Styling Ideas
sections_breakdown.description: Lifestyle vignettes with interactive hotspots (Click on hotspot to view product detail & order on WhatsApp). E.g. 'Corner Plant Layering', 'Console Table Vases', 'Monstera Cement Pillar'.

sections_breakdown.name: Wall Art & Handmade Paintings (Priority 3)
sections_breakdown.description: Editorial gallery of textured canvas art and modern paintings that complement cement and clay decor.

sections_breakdown.name: Decorative Objects & Table Decor (Priority 4)
sections_breakdown.description: Selected handcrafted tabletop accents, marble trays, brass bowls, and decorative candle holders.

sections_breakdown.name: Shop by Room / Interior Inspiration
sections_breakdown.description: Filterable room inspiration cards: Living Room, Balcony Sanctuary, Entryway, and Creative Workspace.

sections_breakdown.name: Our Story
sections_breakdown.description: Artisan narrative on sustainable raw cement, natural pigments, hand-turning techniques, and zero-plastic eco packaging.

sections_breakdown.name: Reviews, FAQs & Footer
sections_breakdown.description: Customer testimonials with star ratings, expandable accordion FAQs for shipping, care instructions, and custom sizes + quick enquiry form modal + sticky WhatsApp floating button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the design direction strictly follows the Organic & Earthy archetype with Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display headings and warm sandstone background #FBF8F5.
Implement line-by-line kinetic entrance reveal for the main hero headline 'Elevate Your Space, Naturally.' using Framer Motion.
Place clear prices in ₹ (INR), dimensions, finish, and stock availability on EVERY product card.
Add 'Order on WhatsApp' (green button with WhatsApp icon) and 'Ask a Question' (outline button) to every product card and Quick View modal.
Construct the Quick View Modal using custom Framer Motion overlay or Shadcn Dialog, showing dimensions, finish, available color swatches, care instructions, and direct WhatsApp order button.
Build the Simple Enquiry Form with fields: Name, Phone Number, City, Product Interest, and Message.
Ensure every interactive element has a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
Create a sticky glassmorphism header with Avora Homes custom SVG logo, navigation anchors, search/filter, and WhatsApp direct contact.
Include a floating WhatsApp button at the bottom-right of the screen for instant customer support.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for stable testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rules: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Never rely on default transparent background on sticky header or dropdowns; backdrop-blur with warm background opacity is mandatory.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.mobile_first: Ensure responsive layout for all grid sections (1 col on mobile, 2 col on tablet, 3-4 col on desktop).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.animations: Use smooth Framer Motion transitions with reduced motion checks.
